audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer had no cooldowns and pointed Riposte at the wrong spell (his Q).
audit.why: Searing Charge (14/13.5/13/12.5/12s) is the immobilising knockup — that is the parry that returns a stun. Bellows Breath (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) is an unstoppable channel Riposte cannot cancel. Volcanic Rupture (9/8.5/8/7.5/7s) leaves a pillar that walls your Lunge. The content layer already had this right; the full layer did not.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with all three timers and the correct parry target.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Ornn must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Bellows Breath arrives: unstoppable channel, a shield, and Brittle on you. Trades even out — take short ones only.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Ornn carry threat 6/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: He self-itemizes without recalling, so his resists climb while you get no back-timer — take towers before his second item.

edits.before: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: matchup-defining — Wall-knockup setup. Don’t get pinned. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Searing Charge: 14s at rank 1 — parry the dash-knockup and it returns as a stun. - Bellows Breath is 12s and unstoppable; Riposte will not cancel it. - Volcanic Rupture: 9s pillar, do not fight beside it.
